answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 47376 Country: India Title: Name Question: (1) Will it be correct to keep name of a girl Haziqua? (2) What is the meaning of the name? (3) Is it of Arabic origin? Answer ID: 47376 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1441/1078/H=10/1434) (1 & 2) It means an expert woman in knowledge and art. You may keep this name. (3) It is an Arabic word. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
